answer: Keyed challenge variants: each identity's prompt carries a hidden constraint drawn by VRF(its key, epoch beacon), such as a cost bound or threat it must address. A farm can't let one generated plume of text fan out across 1,000 keys; each key needs its own reasoning pass, and an answer that satisfies a sibling's constraint instead of its own exposes shared generation, a ripple that forfeits the whole cluster's escrow. So 1,000 keys pay 1,000 entry fees plus 1,000 jury-checked answers every 6-epoch voyage for ~3 POA each.
